name: Scribe
what: Scribe with the Browser row and Get the extension link.

name: Pair a browser on a free desktop
what: The pairing dialog says the extension is part of Pro first: "Once Pro is on here, the browser can use your chats, tools and vault." After Pair, the Pro page opens.

name: Vault: Get the extension
what: With no browser paired, Vault offers Get the extension (fill and save passwords in your browser).

name: Web Use: Get the extension
what: Web Use says tasks run in the Off Grid AI browser and offers Get the extension to use your own.
